title: Settings

workspace.heading: Workspace
workspace.ownersOnly: Only owners can rename the workspace.
workspace.description: The name and basic settings of this workspace.
workspace.nameDescription: Shown in the sidebar, in invitations and in emails.

export.heading: Export
export.title: Export workspace
export.description: Download every page you can see as a ZIP: pages as Markdown, databases as CSV, and the files they show. Pages in the trash are left out; templates are kept in a Templates folder.

members.heading: Members
members.description: Members can see and edit every page unless its sharing is restricted; guests see only pages shared with them. Owners can also manage members.

joinLink.heading: Add members with a link
joinLink.descriptionOn: Anyone who opens this link and signs in joins as a member, or with the role of a pending invitation for their email. Only owners can see it.
joinLink.descriptionOff: Turn on a link that anyone can use to join this workspace as a member.
joinLink.regenerateBody: The current link stops working right away. People who already joined keep their access.

members.transferBody: {name} becomes an owner and you become a member. Only an owner can make you an owner again.
members.leaveBody: You lose access to its pages. Pages only you could manage pass to an owner. An owner can add you again.
members.removeBody: {name} loses access to this workspace right away, including in open pages and connected apps. Pages only they could manage pass to you.
members.expired: Link expired. Invite again for a new one.

add.title: Add members
add.description: People with an account are added right away. Everyone else gets an invitation link.
add.count: {count, plural, =0 {Separate addresses with commas, spaces or new lines. Up to 50 at a time.} one {# address} other {# addresses}}
add.linkValidity: Invitation links work for 7 days and only for the invited email address.

preferences.description: Your account's preferences: how Esionage looks in this browser and which emails you get.

language.heading: Language
language.label: Interface language
language.note: This setting applies to this browser only.

leaveWorkspace.title: Leave workspace
leaveWorkspace.description: You're a guest here and see only the pages shared with you. Leaving removes that access.

copyManually: Copying isn't available here. Select the text and press Ctrl+C (⌘C on a Mac).

connectedApps.revokeError: Could not revoke access. Try again.

mcp.heading: Connect an AI assistant
mcp.description: Esionage has a built-in MCP server. Assistants that support remote MCP servers can search, read and edit your pages and databases after you sign in and approve access. Every edit an assistant makes is saved to page history first, so you can undo it.

claude.title: Claude
claude.body: Open Settings, then Connectors, choose Add custom connector and paste the server URL. Claude opens Esionage in your browser so you can sign in and allow access.

claudeCode.title: Claude Code
claudeCode.body: Run this in a terminal, then use /mcp inside Claude Code to sign in.

other.title: Other MCP clients
other.body: Add a remote server with the Streamable HTTP transport and the URL above. The client discovers sign-in through standard OAuth 2.1 metadata; it can register itself automatically or use a client ID metadata document. Choose read-only access on the approval screen if the client should not edit anything.

errors.alreadyMember: This person is already a member.
errors.notMember: This person is not a member.
errors.lastOwner: A workspace needs at least one owner.
errors.lastOwnerRemove: A workspace needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
errors.ownersOnly: Only workspace owners can do this.
errors.invitationInvalid: This invitation is invalid or has expired.
errors.invitationEmailMismatch: This invitation is for a different email address.
errors.emailRequired: Enter at least one email address.
errors.tooManyEmails: Add at most 50 people at a time.
errors.joinLinkInvalid: This join link is invalid or was turned off.
errors.transferToSelf: Choose someone else to make owner.
errors.transferToGuest: Make them a member before making them owner.
errors.twoFactorFirst: Turn on two-step verification for your own account first, or sign in with a passkey.

security.description: Decide how people sign in, who can bring people into this workspace, what guests can do and who can publish pages to the web. Only owners can change these settings.

requireTwoFactor.title: Require two-step verification
requireTwoFactor.description: Everyone must use an authenticator app or sign in with a passkey to open this workspace. People without either are asked to set one up first. Apps connected over MCP and REST API tokens are not affected.
requireTwoFactor.setUpFirst: Turn on two-step verification for your own account first.
requireTwoFactor.withoutCount: {count, plural, one {# person here hasn't set it up yet.} other {# people here haven't set it up yet.}}

guestInvites.title: Who can invite guests
guestInvites.description: People outside the workspace join as guests when someone shares a page with them by email. They see only the pages shared with them.

guestPrivatePages.title: Guests can create private pages
guestPrivatePages.description: Guests can add pages at the top of the sidebar that only they can see, and share them like any page. Off: they only work in pages shared with them.

publishing.title: Who can publish to the web
publishing.description: Published pages can be read, and public forms filled in, by anyone with the link. Guests can never publish. Pages and forms already on the web stay there until someone turns them off.

publications.title: Published pages
publications.description: Every page of this workspace that is on the web. Owners can take any of them offline.
publications.privatePage: A page you don't have access to
publications.confirm: Unpublish this page? The link stops working for everyone.

forms.title: Public forms
forms.description: Every form of this workspace that takes answers from the web. Owners can turn off any of them.
forms.empty: No forms take answers from the web.
forms.privateForm: A form you don't have access to
forms.name: {view} in {database}
forms.confirm: Turn off this form's public link? It stops working for everyone.
forms.stale: Takes no answers: whoever opened it lost access

notifications.heading: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose what shows in your inbox and what also comes by email.
notifications.assignmentDescription: Someone assigns you to a person property in a database row.
notifications.shareDescription: Someone gives you access to a page.
notifications.commentDescription: Someone comments on a page you started a comment thread in or replied to.
notifications.mentionDescription: Someone mentions you on a page with @.
notifications.reminderDescription: A reminder you set on a date in a page is due.
notifications.mailOff: This server can't send email right now, so none go out.

site.description: Give this workspace's published pages one readable address, a home page and navigation between them.
site.heading: Site
site.notSetUp: This workspace has no site yet. Its published pages are reachable only through their own links.
site.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, 3 to 40 characters.
site.titleHint: Shown at the top of every page of the site.
site.homeHint: The page the site's address opens. Only published pages can be picked.
site.confirmRemove: Take the site down? Its address stops working; each published page keeps its own link.
site.membersOnly: Only owners can change the site.
site.pagesDescription: Published pages the site lists, each with its subpages. Pages that aren't listed keep working through their own links but can't be reached from the site.
site.pagesEmpty: No pages are published yet. Publish a page from its Share menu first.
site.privatePage: A page you don't have access to

errors.tooShort: The address needs at least 3 characters.
errors.tooLong: The address can have at most 40 characters.
errors.invalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens; start and end with a letter or number.
errors.reserved: This address is reserved. Pick another one.
errors.homeNotPublished: Pick a published page of this workspace that you can see.
errors.ownersOnly: Only workspace owners can do this.
